policy: NEXUM licence policy for the UI dependency tree (Phase 2). NEXUM is distributed under MIT.

runtime_distributed.description: Packages reachable from package.json 'dependencies': their code is bundled into ui/dist and distributed.

build_only.description: Packages installed only to build and test (not reachable from runtime dependencies, never bundled).

exceptions.introduced_by: vite@8.3.1 (direct, non-optional dependency: default CSS minifier of the build)
conditions: build-only: not reachable from runtime dependencies (verified)
not included in the distributed bundle ui/dist (verified: no file of the package, no import of it)
not copied or modified inside the project outside node_modules (verified)
MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: it applies to distributed (modified) MPL files; NEXUM distributes none, so the MIT distribution of NEXUM is unaffected
exceptions.not_a_general_rule: MPL-2.0 is NOT allowed for any other package
